quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly completes acquisition of AtaiBeckley to advance (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lilly completed its acquisition of AtaiBeckley, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing rapid-acting neuroplastogens for mental health conditions, including BPL-003, its lead investigational program for treatment-resistant depression. Carole Ho (EVP, president, Lilly Neuroscience) said AtaiBeckley's neuroplastogens have the potential to open a new paradigm of treatment, with rapid-acting therapeutics designed to move away from chronic dosing.
quarterly_data.figure: acquisition completed; lead program BPL-003 (treatment-resistant depression)
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: acquired company (neuroplastogens for mental health conditions)
